title: Radioligand Binding Assay Experiment Conditions
description: A schema to store experimental conditions for a Radioligand Binding Assay (RBA), based on published literature.

pmid.description: The PubMed ID of the publication.

biological_preparation.description: Details about the biological source containing the target receptor.

source_type.description: The type of biological material used.

tissue_or_cell_line.description: The tissue, cell line, or expression system used.

species.description: The species origin of the biological preparation.

target_protein.description: The receptor or protein target being studied, including isoform or subunit composition if specified.

protein_concentration.description: The concentration of membrane protein or cells per well/tube, including units. Heterogeneous field: may be mass-based (ug/well, ug/tube, ug/mL) or cell-count-based (cells/well). Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings, not Unicode micro.

radioligand.description: Details about the radiolabeled probe used in the assay.

name.description: The name of the radioligand, including the isotope label.

specific_activity.description: The specific activity of the radioligand.

value.description: Numeric value of the specific activity. Use a string to capture ranges or approximations.

concentration_used.description: The concentration of radioligand used in the assay, as a number in nanomolar (nM). Convert from other molar units: pM / 1000, uM × 1000, mM × 1000000. Return null if the paper reports only a qualitative value (e.g., '~Kd concentration') or uses units that cannot be converted to nM. Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings elsewhere in the schema, not Unicode micro.

kd_value.description: The known dissociation constant (Kd) of the radioligand for the target, required for Ki calculation via Cheng-Prusoff.

value.description: Kd value as a number in nanomolar (nM). Convert from other units: uM × 1000, pM / 1000. Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings, not Unicode micro.

source.description: Whether the Kd was determined in-house or taken from literature.

test_compound.description: Details about the unlabeled compound(s) being evaluated.

description.description: A general description of the test compound(s).

concentration_range.description: The range of concentrations tested for the competition curve, as a string with all concentrations normalized to micromolar (uM). Convert from other molar units: nM / 1000, pM / 1000000, mM × 1000. Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings, not Unicode micro.

vehicle_solvent.description: The solvent used to dissolve the test compounds and its final assay concentration.

nsb_definition.description: How nonspecific binding (NSB) was defined in the assay. This is critical for data interpretation.

compound_name.description: The unlabeled compound used to define 100% displacement (nonspecific binding).

compound_concentration.description: The concentration of the NSB-defining compound as a number in micromolar (uM). Convert from other molar units: nM / 1000, mM × 1000. Return null if the paper uses units that cannot be converted to uM. Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings, not Unicode micro.

selectivity_rationale.description: Whether the NSB compound is selective for the target, or a broad/non-selective displacer.

assay_format.description: The physical format of the assay.

buffer_composition.description: The full composition of the incubation buffer, including salts and additives. Exclude pH here; use the separate pH field.
examples: 50 mM Tris-HCl, 120 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 1 mM EDTA
50 mM HEPES, 10 mM MgCl2, 100 mM NaCl

pH.description: The pH of the incubation buffer.

incubation_temperature.description: The temperature during incubation. Use a string to allow for 'room temperature'.

incubation_time.description: The duration of incubation as a number in minutes. Convert from other units: h × 60, s / 60. Use a string to capture ranges (e.g., '60-120').

equilibrium_confirmed.description: Whether the authors confirmed that binding had reached equilibrium (e.g., via a time course).

total_assay_volume.description: The total volume of the assay mixture as a number in microliters (uL). Convert from other units: mL × 1000. Use ASCII 'u' in unit strings, not Unicode micro.

separation_and_detection.description: How bound and free radioligand were separated and how radioactivity was measured.

separation_method.description: The method used to separate bound from free radioligand.

filter_type.description: The type of filter used, if filtration-based. Null if not applicable.

wash_protocol.description: The wash conditions after filtration. Null if not applicable.

detection_instrument.description: The instrument used to measure radioactivity.

scintillation_cocktail.description: The scintillation cocktail used for liquid scintillation counting. Null if gamma counting or proximity-based.

data_analysis.description: Details about how the raw data was processed and modeled.

endpoint_reported.description: The primary binding parameter reported in the publication.

ic50_to_ki_conversion.description: The method used to convert IC50 to Ki, if applicable. Null if Ki was not derived from IC50.

fitting_model.description: The model used to fit competition or saturation binding curves.

hill_slope_reported.description: Whether a Hill slope (nH) was reported and its value, if available. nH ≠ 1 may indicate cooperativity or binding heterogeneity.

value.description: The Hill slope value if reported as variable. Null if fixed or not reported.

software.description: The software used for curve fitting and data analysis.

replicates.description: The number of replicates and independent experiments.

technical_replicates.description: Number of replicates per concentration within a single experiment (e.g., duplicate, triplicate).

independent_experiments.description: Number of independent experiments (n). Use a string to capture ranges.
